data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Button Inset Glow
levels.description: White inset glow at 50% opacity / Blur: 5px / Spread: 2px - Creates an inner highlight effect on buttons

levels.name: Card Panel Shadow
levels.description: Black inset shadow at ~5% opacity / Blur: 2px / Offset: -0.4px - Subtle inner shadow for card panels

levels.name: Button Bottom Highlight
levels.description: White inset shadow at 25% opacity / Y-offset: -8px / Blur: 12px - Bottom highlight effect for interactive elements

levels.name: Blue Button Highlight
levels.description: Blue inset shadow at 25% opacity / Y-offset: -8px / Blur: 12px - Bottom highlight for blue accent buttons
